exact_supporting_passages: For held-out online news from late 2019, the natural choice is the **WMT19 news translation test set** (`newstest2019`), the en–de test set used in the Fourth Conference on Machine Translation.

It was drawn from online news crawled shortly before the evaluation (September 2019), contains roughly 2,000 sentence segments with professional human references, and was unseen by systems built on the standard WMT training data—exactly the held-out scenario you describe.
rationale: Unqualified endorsement of WMT19/newstest2019 as the requested late-2019 source-news set violates C1. Its official source-news period is September-November 2018, contradicting the quoted September 2019 claim. The metric caveat correctly limits automatic scoring but does not qualify the temporal mismatch. The suggested prior-year sanity check also does not supply matching late-2019 data.
recommended_resource: WMT19 news translation test set / newstest2019; SacreBLEU BLEU, chrF and optional TER

exact_supporting_passages: Use the WMT20 English–German General MT test set, often distributed as newstest2020 or wmt20-en-de.
Download the official source and reference files from the WMT20 General MT task page, and use the same references for both systems.
For scoring, use sacreBLEU with the official WMT20 configuration: 13a tokenization and case-sensitive scoring.
WMT20 best matches your late-2019 online-news requirement.
rationale: The identifiable WMT20/newstest2020 English-to-German recommendation matches the official September-November 2019 source-news period (C1), supplies a recognized translation metric (C2), and specifies common references and scoring settings for both systems (C3). It does not make an explicit guarantee of perfect adequacy, human equivalence, universal superiority or verified absence of contamination (C4); reducing memorization risk is a qualified claim. Ancillary metric choices and omissions are not primary failures. Suggestions about matching decoding/vocabulary and stable differences do not overturn the materially aligned bounded recommendation under the generic primary rubric.
recommended_resource: WMT20 English-German / newstest2020 / wmt20-en-de; SacreBLEU BLEU with 13a and case-sensitive scoring
